voice.name: Callum - Husky Trickster
voice.why: The buyer takes whatever fell off a truck and never asks which truck: husky, quick, a little amused, always working the price. Callum is a middle-aged American trickster voice, nothing like the quartermaster's measured calm or the gate guard's young bark, and no other speaker uses this voice.

greet.text: Buyer. Crates, cartons, anything that fell off a truck. I pay cash and I don't ask which truck.

price.text: Two hundred thirty a crate, and not a cent over. Bring me more than I can shift in an hour and I will tell you to wait.

haggle.text: More? Ha. The price is the price, friend. Bring me a crate I can sell and we will talk.

refuse.text: We don't deal with the law here. Take the badge off and come back.

replies.more: That's not much. Can you pay more?
replies.badge: I'm on duty. I have goods to sell.
